title: Why You Still Translate in Your Head (3-Step Fix)
description:
If you understand English but freeze when speaking, you have a translation habit your brain built before you turned 15. This episode is the 3-minute daily drill that rewires it.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
The 300-millisecond cost of translating every sentence
3 signs you have a translation habit (and which one is yours)
Why you can't will it away (and what actually works)
The Stanford 2022 study: 41% faster speaking in 14 days
The 3-minute daily drill: object naming + verb mapping + image replacement
Diego's 6-year translation habit, gone in 42 minutes total
